knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Soil from the toilet can be transferred to clean-touch surfaces if the same cloth is used.
Colour meanings are not universal, so the site code controls.
The contaminated item must be removed from use and the affected surface re-cleaned with a clean tool.

practicalCriteria: Sets up separate cloths and tools for at least four bathroom zones before starting.
Demonstrates no cross-zone transfer during a timed simulated clean.
Corrects an intentional cross-zone mistake by removing the item, re-cleaning and recording.
passRule: No uncorrected cross-zone transfer in the simulated clean, and the correction record is complete. Observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Correction record for the simulated mistake
stopWorkCriteria: Toilet tool used on a clean-touch surface without correction
Product mixed or transferred into an unlabelled container
